item.title: RVA Burlesque Bingo September
item.description:
When: Friday, September 4, 2026 · 8pm – 9:30pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Rd Ste A, Richmond, VA 23230

Performance-based burlesque bingo night at Blue Bee Cider featuring Binky Daze, Isabel Astrum, and Luna LaMorgue, with special guests Cece Dynamite and Ember Alert from New Orleans. 21+, doors at 7:30pm.

item.title: Liver Alone 2: A Burlesque Reimagining of Scream 2
item.description:
When: Saturday, September 5, 2026 · 7pm – 9pm

Where: Ember Music Hall, 309 East Broad Street West, Richmond, VA 23219, United States

Horror-burlesque parody of Scream 2 by Ellie Quinn Presents, featuring Caza Blanca, Conejita Luxxe, Ellie Quinn, Empress de Naste', Esther Gin, Kill Gil, London St. Juniper, with New Orleans guests Cece Dynamite and Ember Alert.
